Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiConnectionCycleBoundaryInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiConnectionCycleBoundaryInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiConnectionCycleBoundaryInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source evidence for one connection occurrence crossing a directed-cycle boundary.

The internal and external endpoints are oriented relative to one cyclic strongly connected group. This record does not establish hydraulic continuity, a physical recycle, process intent, or live ProcessSystem topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim
